description:
<!-- Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-24. -->
## YouTube

- **Thumbnail queue:** The RVX queue button now sits in the upper-left of eligible thumbnails, including **Classic** feed cards. Tapping it starts that video if the player is closed. If a video is playing or paused, the button adds the selected video to the queue without interrupting it. The card also exposes an **Add to queue** accessibility action. Available on supported 21.x builds. (#80)
- **Swipe controls:** **RVX → Swipe controls → Swipe overlay foreground color** sets the text and icon color independently of the background and progress bar. The overlay stays the same size as the percentage changes from one to three digits. (#82)
- **Notifications:** Turn on **RVX → Feed → Ungroup notifications** to give grouped channel uploads separate rows, actions and unread dots in the in-app Notifications tab. Off by default. Pages containing only groups stay grouped; Android’s notification shade is unchanged. (#87)
- **Home feed cards:** **Cards** hides Like, Comment and Save on native video cards but keeps the overflow menu. **Cards with like, comment and save buttons** keeps those actions. Both layouts use consistent side margins and card spacing, with a continuous background behind the title and channel name. (#88)

## YouTube Music

- **Third-party lyrics:** Translations of repeated chorus lines now brighten when their own line is sung, rather than appearing highlighted early and dimming on cue. This also works after seeking backward. (#85)

Refresh the RVX patch source in Manager, then repatch and install the app you use.
